item.title: Correction · Power Station Park: The park is now described as the Design for Development draws it: two plain rectangles on either side of Maryland Street, not an irregular shape, with Block 9 not bordering it; an earlier dated note in the map's history that called it one rectangle was corrected. The expected completion moved from 2028 (a press figure) to 2029, the end of Phase 1's schedule in the October 2020 approval, and the note that Block 8 was still seeking financing was corrected: the Chronicle (Aug 2026) says JPMorgan agreed to finance about $200 million and construction is expected to begin in the fall. The Phase 1 street-improvement milestone now says it covers the whole Phase 1 area, that the report gives both April and June 2023 as its start, and that no completion is confirmed. The design review approval of 8.3.21 is no longer attributed to staff, the note that the blocks around the park are still planned was removed (Block 7B has opened), the dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, and the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering.
item.description: The park is now described as the Design for Development draws it: two plain rectangles on either side of Maryland Street, not an irregular shape, with Block 9 not bordering it; an earlier dated note in the map's history that called it one rectangle was corrected. The Phase 1 street-improvement milestone now says it covers the whole Phase 1 area, that the report gives both April and June 2023 as its start, and that no completion is confirmed. The design review approval of 8.3.21 is no longer attributed to staff, the note that the blocks around the park are still planned was removed (Block 7B has opened), the dead 2019 draft link was replaced with the final February 2020 document, and the land-use figure is tagged as a document rather than a rendering. Source: SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Design for Development, final, 2020-02-26 (https://sfplanning.org/sites/default/files/documents/citywide/potreropower_D4D_final.pdf); SF Planning, Potrero Power Station Phase 1 Development Phase Approval, 2020-10-07 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); San Francisco Chronicle, 2026-08-03 (https://www.sfchronicle.com/realestate/article/jpmorgan-housing-san-francisco-22367970.php); California Barrel Company, 2024 Annual Compliance Report, 2025-03-28 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); California Barrel Company, 2021 Annual Report, 2022-03 (https://sfplanning.org/potrero-power-station); SF YIMBY, 2025-10-24 (https://sfyimby.com/2025/10/sophie-maxwell-affordable-housing-opens-in-potrero-power-station-san-francisco.html).
